recommendations.headline: Satisfaction decides sales — win rate jumps from 5% when customers are dissatisfied to 72% when satisfied, yet only 35% of calls (876/2485) end satisfied, while rep gaps like slow/unclear answers (407 calls) and missing follow-ups (394 calls) are leaving most calls (46% end in 'callback', 15% 'unclear') undecided.
behaviour: Price-shopping dominates: price_enquiry is the top intent (850/2485, 34%), price_shopper is the top behaviour tag (432 calls), and 257 calls show customers comparing_quotes across suppliers.
Most calls stall rather than close: 46% end as 'callback' (1144) and 15% as 'unclear' (378), vs only 20% ending in an order.
Price is often never discussed: in 1743 of 2485 calls (70%) price_reaction is 'not_discussed', even though price_enquiry is the #1 intent - suggesting delays in quoting.
Availability and speed drive demand: fast_delivery (461) and stock_availability (453) are the top two stated needs, and stock_availability is the #2 objection (334 calls).
Dealers are the core, best-converting segment: 1187 of 2485 calls (48%) are dealers, converting at 41% - the highest win rate alongside builders (41%).
satisfaction: Satisfaction is the single biggest conversion lever: satisfied calls win 72% of the time vs 15% for neutral and just 5% for dissatisfied calls, but only 35% of calls (876) are rated satisfied.
52% of calls (1286) are merely 'neutral' - a large middle ground that could be shifted to 'satisfied' and dramatically lift conversion.

Price_high is the top objection (340 calls, 14% of all calls) but only wins 28% of the time when raised, and competitor_cheaper (90 calls) wins just 23% - price perception is a real but manageable blocker.
Top rep-side gaps directly hurting satisfaction: slow_or_unclear_answer (407 calls) and no_follow_up_fixed (394 calls) are the two most common missed actions.

conversion.title: Always ask for the order explicitly
conversion.evidence: didnt_ask_for_order flagged in 227 calls; order outcome is only 485/2485 (20%) despite 548 order-intent calls.
conversion.action: Train reps to close every qualifying call with a direct order ask and a specific next step, not an open-ended 'let me check'.

conversion.title: Speed up and clarify answers
conversion.evidence: slow_or_unclear_answer is the #1 rep gap (407 calls); satisfied calls convert at 72% vs 15% for neutral.
conversion.action: Equip reps with a quick-reference rate/stock sheet so they can answer rate, size and stock questions on the spot instead of deferring.

conversion.title: Send quotations immediately, every time
conversion.evidence: no_quote_sent flagged in 230 calls; price not discussed in 70% of all calls (1743) despite price_enquiry being the top intent.
conversion.action: Make WhatsApp quotation/proforma send mandatory within the call or within minutes after, tracked as a KPI.

conversion.title: Fix every callback with a confirmed date/time
conversion.evidence: no_follow_up_fixed in 394 calls; 46% of calls (1144) end as 'callback' with no guaranteed close.
conversion.action: Require reps to log a specific callback date/time in the CRM before ending any undecided call, and have managers audit same-day.

conversion.title: Proactively manage stock and delivery objections
conversion.evidence: stock_availability (334 calls, 25% win) and delivery_time (204 calls, 25% win) are the #2 and #3 objections; fast_delivery and stock_availability are the top two customer needs.
conversion.action: Give reps live stock visibility and standard delivery-window commitments to quote confidently instead of 'I'll check.'

conversion.title: Offer alternatives instead of dead-ending
conversion.evidence: didnt_offer_alternative missed in 135 calls; successful calls show offering an alternative (e.g., half-white instead of unavailable cream) led to accepted orders.
conversion.action: Train reps to always propose a close substitute (colour/thickness/brand) when the exact item is unavailable.

conversion.title: Lead with value, not just price, against competitors
conversion.evidence: didnt_highlight_value missed in 86 calls; competitor_cheaper objection (90 calls) wins only 23% of the time.
conversion.action: Script a short value pitch (JSW authorised distributor, quality, certification) to use whenever a competitor price is quoted.

offers.title: Priority/express delivery slot
offers.why: urgent_buyer tagged in 269 calls, high urgency in 339 calls, fast_delivery is the top stated need (461 calls).

offers.title: Site-direct delivery service
offers.why: site_delivery flagged as a need in 104 calls; multiple successful calls involved site delivery (e.g., Pattabiram).

offers.title: On-demand cutting/processing service
offers.for_whom: Fabricators and sheet buyers needing custom sizes
offers.why: cutting_processing need appears in 101 calls; several converted calls explicitly requested cutting.

offers.title: Fast-turnaround sample programme
offers.why: samples need in 64 calls; several stalled calls are stuck waiting on sample delivery/feedback.

offers.title: Consider structured credit terms for established dealers
offers.why: credit_terms objection (73 calls) actually has the highest win rate (29%) among objections, and needs_credit appears in 97 calls.

offers.title: Ready proforma invoice / quick-quote service for bulk buyers
offers.why: bulk_buyer tagged in 223 calls; several successful calls specifically requested proforma invoices before confirming.

loyalty.title: Consider a formal repeat-buyer recognition programme
loyalty.how: Track repeat_buyer and loyal_to_us tags in CRM and offer small non-price perks (priority slot, dedicated contact) after a set number of orders.
loyalty.why: repeat_buyer tagged 220 times but loyal_to_us only 19 - a big gap between repeat activity and felt loyalty.

loyalty.title: Proactive WhatsApp rate/stock update group for regular dealers
loyalty.how: Push regular rate and new-stock updates to a dealer broadcast list instead of waiting for calls.
loyalty.why: regular_updates is a stated need in 207 calls; several calls complain quotations/updates were not posted in the group.

loyalty.title: Dedicated account contact for top dealers/bulk buyers
loyalty.how: Assign a named rep/manager to the highest-volume dealer and bulk accounts for continuity.
loyalty.why: Dealers are 48% of all calls (1187) with the highest win rate (41%); consistent_supply is a stated need in 121 calls.

loyalty.title: Proactively share test certificates and quality documents
loyalty.how: Attach certificate/quality docs with every dispatch by default, not only on request.
loyalty.why: test_certificate requested in 19 calls, quality_assurance is a need in 126 calls, and quality_doubt objection appears in 93 calls.

loyalty.title: Formalise festival gifting for loyal fabricators/dealers
loyalty.how: Plan an annual small-gift gesture (as already informally done) tied to order history.
loyalty.why: Diwali gift was specifically asked about in multiple successful calls, showing it is noticed and valued.

loyalty.title: Scheduled after-sales check-in calls
loyalty.how: Call customers a few days after delivery to confirm satisfaction and catch issues early.
loyalty.why: after_sales_support need appears in 43 calls and complaint intent accounts for 174 calls (7%).

non_price_benefits.title: Technical advisory on specs (GSM, coating, thickness)
non_price_benefits.why: needs_technical_help tagged in 354 calls and technical_advice is a stated need in 397 calls - the 3rd highest need overall.

non_price_benefits.title: Fast and site-direct delivery capability
non_price_benefits.why: fast_delivery (461) and site_delivery (104) are top stated needs; urgent_buyer behaviour appears in 269 calls.

non_price_benefits.title: Wide colour and product range in stock
non_price_benefits.why: stock_availability is the top stated need (453) and many calls ask for specific colours (grey, CG green, cream/9001).

non_price_benefits.title: Authorised JSW distributor quality and certification
non_price_benefits.why: quality_assurance need in 126 calls, test_certificate requests in 19 calls, and quality_doubt objection in 93 calls show quality reassurance is persuasive.

non_price_benefits.title: Reliable, consistent supply for repeat orders
non_price_benefits.why: consistent_supply is a need in 121 calls and bulk_buyer behaviour appears in 223 calls.

non_price_benefits.title: Convenient cutting/customisation service
non_price_benefits.why: cutting_processing need appears in 101 calls and multiple successful calls specifically requested cutting as part of closing the order.

top_questions.question: What is the current rate/price for [product/size/colour]?
top_questions.answer_tip: Quote confidently and promptly using a ready rate reference; avoid 'I'll check and call back' where the rate is known.

top_questions.question: Is stock available (for this colour/size/quantity)?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a clear yes/no with live stock status; if unavailable, immediately offer the closest alternative.

top_questions.question: Can you deliver today/tomorrow or at a specific time?
top_questions.answer_tip: Commit to a realistic delivery window and confirm it back in writing (WhatsApp) to avoid follow-up calls.

top_questions.question: Can you reduce the price / give a discount?
top_questions.answer_tip: Acknowledge the request, then pivot to value points (quality, certification, reliability, service) rather than promising a cut on the call.

top_questions.question: Why is your price higher than a competitor's?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain brand authenticity (authorised JSW distributor), quality assurance and after-sales support as the reason for the price difference.

top_questions.question: Can you send the quotation/proforma invoice?
top_questions.answer_tip: Send it immediately via WhatsApp during or right after the call rather than deferring.

top_questions.question: Is a specific colour/thickness available for a large/bulk order?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm bulk-order arrangement capability and timeline clearly; if not in current stock, explain how it can be sourced.

top_questions.question: Can I get credit terms / pay after delivery?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain the current credit policy clearly and escalate to a manager for case-by-case evaluation rather than guessing.
